title: BPMN process-variable manifest
description: Declares process variables for a BPMN diagram's inline scripts. Lives at <configFolder>/vars/<relativeBpmnPath>.bpmn.vars.json and is merged on top of the heuristic variable discovery (authored entries win a name clash).

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference. The modeler already associates this schema by file name, so this is only needed for editors that don't.

variables.description: The declared process variables. Each entry adds (or overrides, on a name clash) a variable offered in inline-script completion.

name.description: The variable name as referenced in scripts (e.g. execution.getVariable("orderId")). Required.

type.description: Optional author type hint, shown in completion. A few hints (e.g. SpinJsonNode) also drive member completion; otherwise any label is fine (String, Long, Boolean, ...).

description.description: Optional human-readable documentation, shown in the completion popup.
